images.filename: USS Alabama (BB-60) fires guns 1943.jpg
images.caption: The U.S. Navy battleship USS Alabama (BB-60) firing her 40.6 cm guns during combined British and American fleet exercises. The photograph was taken from the Royal Navy battleship HMS Anson (79).Alabama and USS South Dakota (BB-57) operated with the British Home Fleet in 1943. In June 1943, the ships, together with HMS Duke of York (17) and HMS Anson took part in "Operation Gearbox" (to Spitsbergen).
images.alt: The U.S. Navy battleship USS Alabama (BB-60) firing her 40.6 cm guns during combined British and American fleet exercises. The photograph was taken from the Royal Navy battleship HMS Anson (79).Alabama and USS South Dakota (BB-57) operated with the British Home Fleet in 1943. In June 1943, the ships, together with HMS Duke of York (17) and HMS Anson took part in "Operation Gearbox" (to Spitsbergen).
images.artist: Lt. J.A. Hampton, Royal Navy official photographer
categories: Black and white photographs of ships

images.filename: Forward superstructure of USS Alabama (BB-60), December 1942.jpg
images.caption: View of the ship's forward superstructure, looking up from the port side during her shakedown period, circa December 1942. Note: Signal flags; Mk.8 fire control radar on Mk.38 main battery gun director (at top); Mk.4 fire control radar on Mk.37 secondary battery gun director at right; radio direction finder "loop" at left.
images.alt: View of the ship's forward superstructure, looking up from the port side during her shakedown period, circa December 1942. Note: Signal flags; Mk.8 fire control radar on Mk.38 main battery gun director (at top); Mk.4 fire control radar on Mk.37 secondary battery gun director at right; radio direction finder "loop" at left.

images.filename: Aircraft carriers at Seattle in January 1947.jpg
images.caption: U.S. Navy ships at Seattle, Washington (USA), on 9 January 1947. Three aircraft carriers are at Pier 91, USS Bunker Hill (CV-17), USS Bon Homme Richard (CV-31) and USS Essex (CV-9). USS Ticonderoga (CV-14) is at Pier 92. The battleships USS Indiana (BB-58) and USS Alabama (BB-60) are moored opposite of the Ticonderoga.
images.alt: U.S. Navy ships at Seattle, Washington (USA), on 9 January 1947. Three aircraft carriers are at Pier 91, USS Bunker Hill (CV-17), USS Bon Homme Richard (CV-31) and USS Essex (CV-9). USS Ticonderoga (CV-14) is at Pier 92. The battleships USS Indiana (BB-58) and USS Alabama (BB-60) are moored opposite of the Ticonderoga.

images.filename: USS Massachusetts (BB-59) at Casco Bay 1943.jpg
images.caption: The U.S. Navy battleship USS Massachusetts (BB-59) seen from the after deck of USS Alabama (BB-60), in Casco Bay, Maine (USA), January 1943. The muzzles of Alabama´s after 40.6 cm/45 guns are in the foreground.
images.alt: The U.S. Navy battleship USS Massachusetts (BB-59) seen from the after deck of USS Alabama (BB-60), in Casco Bay, Maine (USA), January 1943. The muzzles of Alabama´s after 40.6 cm/45 guns are in the foreground.

images.filename: Forward guns of USS Alabama (BB-60) c1942.jpg
images.caption: The forward 40.6 cm/45 guns of the U.S. Navy battleship USS Alabama (BB-60) train to starboard during a North Atlantic battle practice. Photographed during her shakedown period, circa December 1942 - January 1943. Note the ice and snow on turrets and decks.
images.alt: The forward 40.6 cm/45 guns of the U.S. Navy battleship USS Alabama (BB-60) train to starboard during a North Atlantic battle practice. Photographed during her shakedown period, circa December 1942 - January 1943. Note the ice and snow on turrets and decks.

images.filename: B6N drops torpedo off USS Essex (CV-9) in October 1944.jpg
images.caption: An Imperial Japanese Navy Nakajima B6N ("Jill") releases its torpedo off the starboard bow of the U.S. Navy aircraft carrier USS Essex (CV-9) off Formosa on 14 October 1944. In the background are the battleship USS Alabama (BB-60), right, and a destroyer, center.
images.alt: An Imperial Japanese Navy Nakajima B6N ("Jill") releases its torpedo off the starboard bow of the U.S. Navy aircraft carrier USS Essex (CV-9) off Formosa on 14 October 1944. In the background are the battleship USS Alabama (BB-60), right, and a destroyer, center.
images.artist: U.S. Navy (the image is part of an album of photographs collected by Captain Carlos W. Wieber during his command of the aircraft carrier USS Essex (CV-9) during 1944-1945).
